messages.content: List exactly three things to pack for a school picnic. Use a numbered list.

1. A water bottle
2. A tiffin box with lunch
3. A cap for the sun
Describe the monsoon in one sentence of under 15 words.
Dark clouds roll in, and warm rain soaks the dusty streets.
Give me five words that rhyme with "cat", on one line, separated by commas.
bat, hat, mat, rat, sat
Write one sentence, in question form only, inviting a friend to a film on Saturday.
Would you like to come and watch a film with me on Saturday evening?
Write four lines about chai, and start each line with the letter T.

Tea leaves swirl in the boiling water.
The milk turns it a warm, soft brown.
Two spoons of sugar make it sweet.
That first hot sip feels like home.
How do I water a potted plant? Exactly four numbered steps, please.

1. Check that the top of the soil feels dry.
2. Fill a jug with water at room temperature.
3. Pour slowly around the base until water drains out of the bottom.
4. Empty the saucer so the roots do not sit in water.
In two sentences, describe a busy railway station without using the word "people".
Crowds rush across the platforms, dragging suitcases and calling to one another. Tea sellers shout over the noise as a late train pulls in.
Give exactly two tips for remembering new English words, and keep the whole answer under 30 words.

1. Use each new word in a sentence about your own life.
2. Say it aloud again the next day and a week later.
Write a one-sentence birthday wish for my grandmother that uses the word "sunshine".
Happy birthday, Grandma, you have been the sunshine of our home for as long as I can remember.
Name exactly five green vegetables, one per line, and nothing else.

Spinach
Peas
Okra
Cabbage
Broccoli
Tell me why sleep matters in exactly 10 words.
Sleep helps your body rest and your mind stay sharp.
Turn this statement into a question: Ravi finished his homework before dinner.
Did Ravi finish his homework before dinner?
Write three sentences about a cricket match. Each sentence must have exactly six words.
The bowler ran in very fast. The batter hit it over midwicket. Everyone in the stands cheered loudly.
Make a packing list for a two-day trip to the hills: exactly six items, in alphabetical order.

1. Charger
2. Jacket
3. Socks
4. Sunscreen
5. Toothbrush
6. Umbrella
Draft a polite reminder to my colleague Leela about our 3 p.m. meeting. Keep it under 25 words and include the word "agenda".
Hi Leela, a quick reminder about our meeting at 3 p.m. today. Please bring the agenda we discussed yesterday. Thanks!
Write a rhyming couplet about a lost umbrella. Two lines only.

I left my red umbrella on the bus one day,
And now the rain just laughs and soaks me on my way.
Give five synonyms for "tired", in lowercase, separated by commas.
exhausted, weary, sleepy, drained, fatigued
I missed my friend's call. Write her a short apology text in exactly two sentences, and don't use the word "sorry".
I missed your call because my phone was on silent during class. I apologise, and I'll ring you back as soon as I get home.
Explain what a library card is in under 20 words, for a six-year-old.
A library card is a special card that lets you take books home and bring them back later.
Five words describing a festival night, please, each starting with a different vowel.
amazing, echoing, illuminated, overflowing, uplifting
